capability_declaration.evidence: IEC 61850-7-4 (Logical Nodes) and IEC 61850-6 (Configuration description language - SCL)
capability_declaration.rationale: IEC 61850 explicitly defines standardized logical nodes and data models for DER capabilities, enabling devices/agents to declare their functionalities.

bounded_authority.rationale: The standard partially covers authority limits via access control (e.g., roles in SCL) and DER operational constraints, but lacks explicit revocation/expiry mechanisms.

decision_auditability.evidence: IEC 61850-7-2 (Logging and reporting services) and IEC 61850-8-1 (GOOSE/SV logging)
decision_auditability.rationale: IEC 61850 supports logging of events and decisions, but attribution to specific agents is not fully standardized.

data_governance.evidence: IEC 61850-6 (SCL for data modeling) and IEC 61850-7-4 (Data ownership inferred from logical nodes)
data_governance.rationale: Data governance is implicitly covered via data modeling and ownership inference, but explicit requirements on consent/retention are absent.
